snippet.title: DevLog#1: Spring adventures cosy game in Unreal Engine 5
snippet.description:
🎮 Welcome to my first Devlog!
In this episode, I’m sharing the very first steps in developing my indie game in Unreal Engine 5. It’s a cosy exploration adventure where you collect carrots, discover cute animals, and unlock tools to help you on your journey. 🐇🔦🔍

You’ll get a look at:
🌿 The basic world setup in UE5
🥕 How carrots work as the main currency
🧰 The first tool system (like the Magnifying Glass and Flashlight)
🧩 Some small puzzles and exploration elements
🐾 Early concept of animals you can find in the world

It’s still very early in development, but I’m excited to show you the progress and share how the world is starting to come alive!

If you enjoy cosy exploration games or just like seeing UE5 projects grow from the ground up, stick around for future devlogs!

If you’d like to see a tutorial on how I made any part of the game, feel free to leave a comment or reach out — I’d love to share how I did it!

👇 Subscribe to follow the development journey!
